segments.speaker: Maya Chen, Account Executive
segments.text:
Hi Jordan,

Attached is the order form for 42 seats of the service desk package, plus the onboarding block we scoped last week.

Start date: August 19, 2026
Term: 12 months
Total: $58,740
Billing: annual upfront

I left the invoice contact as ap@northbankmechanical.com. Let me know if that should be someone else.

Maya

segments.speaker: Jordan Ellis, IT Operations Manager
segments.text:
Hi Maya,

Thanks. Two items:

1. We only need 39 seats at go-live. The other 3 hires are not approved yet.
2. Annual upfront is okay, but our controller needs the invoice dated after Sept 1.

Can you revise?

Jordan

segments.speaker: Maya Chen, Account Executive
segments.text:
Yeah, no problem.

I updated to 39 seats and kept the same August 19 service start. Invoice can be generated Sept 2 with net 30 terms, so due Oct 2.

Revised total is $54,405 including onboarding.

Maya

segments.speaker: Jordan Ellis, IT Operations Manager
segments.text:
Maya,

We are close, but the CFO asked me to keep this under $52k for the first year. If we cannot get there, I may need to push the go-live to Q4 and rebid the onboarding work.

Jordan

segments.speaker: Maya Chen, Account Executive
segments.text:
Jordan,

Understood. As we covered in messages, I can get you to $51,900 for year one if you can sign by Friday; I'll clean up the deal desk paperwork after so the order form matches.

Everything else stays the same: 39 seats, Aug 19 go-live, Sept 2 invoice, net 30.

Maya

segments.speaker: Jordan Ellis, IT Operations Manager
segments.text:
Okay, that works.

Please send the final order form at $51,900. Also confirm the renewal is based on list less the standard 8% discount, not this first-year number.

Jordan

segments.speaker: Maya Chen, Account Executive
segments.text:
Correct. Renewal language will show year two pricing at then-current list less 8%, with a 5% annual cap on increases after that.

I'll send the final PDF shortly for signature. The implementation manager can still hold the Aug 19 kickoff if we have signature by Aug 2.

Maya

segments.speaker: Jordan Ellis, IT Operations Manager
segments.text:
Sounds good.

Use my signature and send a copy to Lisa Grant in finance. Her email is lgrant@northbankmechanical.com.

Jordan
